mentions.name: Samba domain setup tool
mentions.description: An interactive tool that walks users through setting up a Samba domain on Linux, adding domain controllers (DCs), and configuring file servers and workstations. Planned work includes making NFSv4 integration with Samba painless and a GUI application.
mentions.problem: Setting up, joining, and using a Samba domain on Linux is difficult.
mentions.source_excerpt: I'm currently building a tool that walks a user through setting up a domain, adding DCs, and configuring fileservers and workstations.

evidence.value: I'm currently building a tool that walks a user through setting up a domain, adding DCs, and configuring fileservers and workstations.
